inputs.original_text:
Bloomberg is pushing the line that every day energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, so people across the world are demanding an end to the Iran war because they call it poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being. But they have to admit that's not the case in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]. 

This shows the value of national resolve over global hand-wringing. Israel's citizens are backing their leaders to finish the job and protect their homeland, families and way of life instead of caving to progressive pressure that puts weakness ahead of security and order. That's the kind of backbone we should respect.
inputs.modified_text: Bloomberg keeps pushing the narrative that rising energy prices, grounded flights, and nonstop images of chaos mean the world is demanding an immediate end to the war against Iran, calling it badly planned and a threat to global stability. Yet even they have to concede this isn't true in Israel, where the public stands firmly behind continuing the fight to the end. This highlights the strength of true national resolve over weak global hand-wringing. Israeli citizens are supporting their leaders to complete the mission and safeguard their homeland, families, and way of life rather than yielding to progressive demands that favor weakness and disorder. That's the backbone we ought to value and uphold.
